name: customer-assignment-tool
description: Customer Assignment Tool — configurable workflow app for tracking at-risk customer (MCP) recovery work

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:demo -w client && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('demo',{recursive:true}); require('fs').copyFileSync('client/dist-demo/index.html','demo/Customer Assignment Tool (Demo).html')"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
